import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
const { chromium, webkit } = await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE);
const pngModule = await import(process.env.PNG_MODULE);
const PNG = pngModule.PNG ?? pngModule.default.PNG;
const out = process.env.QA_OUTPUT;
await fs.mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
const report = { checks: [], failures: [], layouts: [], motionSamples: [], comparisons: [] };
const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';
const all = '[data-blog-reveal]';
const pending = '[data-blog-reveal-state="pending"]';
const seconds = (value) => Number.parseFloat(value) * (value.trim().endsWith('ms') ? 0.001 : 1);
async function ready(page, url = `${base}/blog`) {
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.locator('.blog-page').waitFor();
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    await document.fonts.ready;
    await Promise.all([...document.images].map(async (image) => {
      image.loading = 'eager';
      await image.decode();
    }));
  });
}
async function finish(page) {
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
  await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-blog-reveal-state="pending"]').length === 0);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-blog-reveal]')].every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none'));
}
async function open(page, index = 0) {
  const button = page.locator('.article-row__open').nth(index);
  await button.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await button.click();
  await page.locator('.article-dialog[open]').waitFor();
  return button;
}
async function close(page) {
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog'));
  await page.waitForFunction(() => document.body.style.position === '');
}
async function scenario(browser, name, options, run, init) {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, reducedMotion: 'no-preference', ...options });
  if (init) await context.addInitScript(init);
  const page = await context.newPage();
  page.setDefaultTimeout(12000);
  page.setDefaultNavigationTimeout(20000);
  const errors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(String(error)));
  try {
    await run(page, context);
    assert.deepEqual(errors, [], 'runtime errors');
    report.checks.push(name);
  } catch (error) {
    report.failures.push({ name, message: String(error), stack: error.stack });
    try { await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `failure-${report.failures.length}.png`) }); } catch {}
  } finally { await context.close(); }
}

for (const [engineName, engine] of Object.entries({ chromium, webkit })) {
  const browser = await engine.launch();
  for (const width of [320, 390, 700, 701, 900, 1100, 1101, 1280, 1440, 1920]) {
    await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: responsive reveals ${width}px`, { viewport: { width, height: 900 } }, async (page, context) => {
      await ready(page);
      assert.equal(await page.locator(all).count(), 18);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-row').count(), 10);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('h1').count(), 1);
      const dates = await page.locator('.article-row__date').evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((el) => el.dateTime));
      assert.deepEqual(dates, [...dates].sort().reverse());
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-row').last().getAttribute('data-blog-reveal-state'), 'pending');
      const initial = await page.locator('.article-row').last().evaluate((el) => {
        const css = getComputedStyle(el);
        const matrix = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(css.transform);
        return { opacity: css.opacity, x: matrix.m41, y: matrix.m42, duration: css.getPropertyValue('--blog-reveal-duration'), order: css.getPropertyValue('--blog-reveal-order') };
      });
      assert.equal(initial.opacity, '0');
      assert.equal(initial.x, 0);
      assert.equal(initial.y, width <= 700 ? 16 : width <= 1100 ? 22 : 28);
      assert.equal(seconds(initial.duration), width <= 700 ? 0.4 : width <= 1100 ? 0.48 : 0.56);
      assert.equal(Number(initial.order), 0, 'no cumulative article delay');
      await finish(page);
      const layout = await page.evaluate(() => ({ width: innerWidth, scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth, height: document.documentElement.scrollHeight }));
      assert(layout.scrollWidth <= layout.clientWidth + 1, 'horizontal overflow');
      report.layouts.push({ browser: engineName, ...layout });
      if ([390, 1440].includes(width)) {
        await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
        await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
        const actualBuffer = await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engineName}-blog-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
        const referencePage = await context.newPage();
        await ready(referencePage, 'http://127.0.0.1:4174/blog');
        await referencePage.mouse.move(0, 0);
        const referenceBuffer = await referencePage.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engineName}-baseline-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
        const actual = PNG.sync.read(actualBuffer);
        const reference = PNG.sync.read(referenceBuffer);
        assert.equal(actual.width, reference.width);
        assert.equal(actual.height, reference.height);
        let differentPixels = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < actual.data.length; i += 4) {
          if (actual.data[i] !== reference.data[i] || actual.data[i + 1] !== reference.data[i + 1] || actual.data[i + 2] !== reference.data[i + 2] || actual.data[i + 3] !== reference.data[i + 3]) differentPixels++;
        }
        report.comparisons.push({ browser: engineName, width, differentPixels });
        assert.equal(differentPixels, 0, 'unchanged final appearance');
        await referencePage.close();
      }
    });
  }

  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: 15% threshold and intermediate motion`, {}, async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    const row = page.locator('.article-row').nth(2);
    await row.evaluate((el) => {
      const b = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      window.scrollTo({ top: scrollY + b.top - innerHeight + b.height * 0.08, behavior: 'instant' });
    });
    await page.waitForTimeout(120);
    assert.equal(await row.getAttribute('data-blog-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    await row.evaluate((el) => window.scrollBy({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().height * 0.18, behavior: 'instant' }));
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('.article-row')[2].getAnimations().length > 0);
    const sample = await row.evaluate((el) => {
      const animations = el.getAnimations();
      animations.forEach((animation) => {
        animation.pause();
        const timing = animation.effect.getTiming();
        animation.currentTime = timing.delay + timing.duration * 0.35;
      });
      const css = getComputedStyle(el);
      const matrix = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(css.transform);
      const result = { state: el.dataset.blogRevealState, opacity: Number(css.opacity), x: matrix.m41, y: matrix.m42, delay: css.transitionDelay, animations: animations.length };
      animations.forEach((animation) => animation.play());
      return result;
    });
    assert.equal(sample.state, 'visible');
    assert(sample.opacity > 0 && sample.opacity < 1);
    assert(sample.y > 0 && sample.y < 28);
    assert.equal(seconds(sample.delay), 0);
    report.motionSamples.push({ browser: engineName, ...sample });
    await finish(page);
    for (const width of [900, 390, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
      assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0);
      assert(await page.locator(all).evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none' && el.getAnimations().length === 0)));
    }
  });

  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: all ten readers, opening motion and return`, {}, async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    await finish(page);
    await page.evaluate(() => {
      window.__readerAnimations = [];
      document.addEventListener('animationstart', (event) => window.__readerAnimations.push(event.animationName));
    });
    for (let index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
      const button = page.locator('.article-row__open').nth(index);
      await button.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      const y = await page.evaluate(() => scrollY);
      const title = await button.textContent();
      await open(page, index);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog__title').textContent(), title);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog__section').count(), 3);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog [data-blog-reveal]').count(), 0);
      await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('.article-dialog').getAnimations().length === 0);
      if (index === 0) {
        assert((await page.evaluate(() => window.__readerAnimations)).includes('blog-dialog-enter'));
        assert((await page.evaluate(() => window.__readerAnimations)).includes('blog-backdrop-enter'));
        const toolbarY = (await page.locator('.article-dialog__toolbar').boundingBox()).y;
        await page.locator('.article-dialog__scroll').evaluate((el) => { el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; });
        assert.equal((await page.locator('.article-dialog__toolbar').boundingBox()).y, toolbarY);
        await page.locator('.article-dialog__close').focus();
        await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
        assert(await page.locator('.article-dialog__cta').evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement));
        await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
        assert(await page.locator('.article-dialog__close').evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement));
        await page.locator('.article-dialog__scroll').evaluate((el) => { el.scrollTop = 0; });
        await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engineName}-reader-1440.png`) });
      }
      await close(page);
      assert(await button.evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement));
      assert(Math.abs((await page.evaluate(() => scrollY)) - y) < 2);
      assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0);
    }
    await open(page);
    await page.mouse.click(5, 5);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog'));
    await open(page);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close article', exact: true }).click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog'));
    await open(page, 2);
    await page.locator('.article-dialog__cta').click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/contact');
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog') && document.body.style.position === '');
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => history.state.usr.articleId), 'roof-repair-or-replacement');
    assert.equal(await page.locator(all).count(), 0);
  });

  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: anchor navigation and keyboard reveal`, {}, async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Read the Latest', exact: true }).click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => location.hash === '#articles' && document.activeElement.id === 'articles');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#articles').getAttribute('data-blog-reveal-state'), 'static');
    await ready(page, `${base}/blog#articles`);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement.id === 'articles');
    await page.locator('.article-row__open').last().focus();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-row').last().getAttribute('data-blog-reveal-state'), 'static');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-row').last().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
  });

  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: initial reduced motion`, { reducedMotion: 'reduce' }, async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(all).count(), 0);
    await open(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).animationName), 'none');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el, '::backdrop').animationName), 'none');
    await close(page);
  });
  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: live reduced motion and no replay`, {}, async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('[data-blog-reveal-state="pending"]'));
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
    assert(await page.locator(all).evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.every((el) => el.dataset.blogRevealState === 'static' && getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1')));
  });
  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: print exposes all content`, {}, async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('beforeprint')));
    assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0);
    assert(await page.locator(all).evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none')));
  });
  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: unavailable observer fallback`, {}, async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(all).count(), 0);
    await open(page, 9);
    await close(page);
  }, () => { window.IntersectionObserver = undefined; });
  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: StrictMode and route remount`, {}, async (page) => {
    await ready(page, 'http://127.0.0.1:4193/blog');
    assert.equal(await page.locator(all).count(), 18);
    await open(page);
    await close(page);
    await page.locator('.header__contact').click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/contact');
    await page.locator('.header__nav-link[href="/blog"]').click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-blog-reveal]').length === 18);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-row').last().getAttribute('data-blog-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    await finish(page);
  });
  await scenario(browser, `${engineName}: touch reader and mobile motion`, { viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, hasTouch: true, isMobile: true }, async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    await finish(page);
    const button = page.locator('.article-row__open').first();
    await button.tap();
    await page.locator('.article-dialog[open]').waitFor();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('.article-dialog').getAnimations().length === 0);
    const b = await page.locator('.article-dialog').boundingBox();
    assert(b.x >= 0 && b.y >= 0 && b.x + b.width <= 391 && b.y + b.height <= 845);
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.body.style.position), 'fixed');
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engineName}-reader-390.png`) });
    await page.locator('.article-dialog__scroll').evaluate((el) => { el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; });
    await page.locator('.article-dialog__close').tap();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog') && document.body.style.position === '');
    assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0);
  });
  await browser.close();
}
await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, 'report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify({ checks: report.checks.length, failures: report.failures, comparisons: report.comparisons }, null, 2));
if (report.failures.length) process.exitCode = 1;
